topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I can't help but replay the moments leading up to the flight, wondering if there was a way I could have made it all different. The announcement echoed through the terminal, each word weaving a thicker fog around the path I couldn’t seem to clear. I know the importance of the event, the faces there, waiting, expecting. I’m here instead, in this neutral zone of fluorescent lights and delayed flights, my presence felt only by the vacuum of my absence. I’ll make it there eventually, but the moment, the perfect timing, is lost to the shuffle of airplanes and the sky’s unforgiving schedule. I hope you can understand.
